description: Small white bowl of soft dates on dark walnut wood, low-key light, empty dark space on the left for text
Date palm grove with red date clusters over green ground cover (portrait); lush rather than desert
Golden honey flowing from a wooden dipper into a small glass dish on warm stone, soft bright daylight; fingertips just visible top-left
Close-up of ripe golden barley ears with long awns in a field (true barley, not wheat); daylight rather than sunset

Creamy porridge/pudding in a terracotta bowl with crushed nuts and a wooden spoon, warm sunlight on a navy-floral cloth (portrait); reads as a creamy porridge but NO honey or dates visible - so-so match
Same wide daytime Kaaba photo cropped above the foreground group, leaving only the distant, tiny pilgrims on the courtyard (no recognisable face); Kaaba, two minarets and arcades.
High view of the Kaaba at night surrounded by thousands of pilgrims doing tawaf, floodlit arcades; construction cranes in the top edge
Wide daytime view of the Kaaba in Masjid al-Haram with pilgrims in ihram on the white marble courtyard and two minarets; older pre-expansion photo, flat grey sky, small cranes
Same Masjid an-Nabawi golden-hour photo with the crowd strip along the bottom cropped away, so no person or face remains: Green Dome, silver dome, minarets and lamp posts only.
Masjid an-Nabawi in Madinah at golden hour: the Green Dome, silver dome and minarets glowing against a clear blue sky; crowd along the bottom edge (one adult face near centre-bottom, crop if needed)
Two pairs of hands passing a kraft-paper grocery bag (leeks, aubergine) against a plain grey wall, soft side light; no faces, no text (portrait)
Empty mosque prayer hall wall: tiled mihrab niche with Quranic calligraphy, small minbar on the left, turquoise carpet; calm and even but cool-toned rather than warm
Gloved hands ladling steaming pulao/rice from a huge outdoor cauldron into take-away bowls; hands and food only, no faces, no women.

Community meal in Keraniganj, Bangladesh: bearded men ladle khichuri from a huge pot into bowls for distribution; authentic South Asian Muslim context, adult faces visible, documentary rather than polished (small Bengali text on one cap)  [REPLACED by the halal no-face policy: faces]
Overhead view of two people's hands working on laptops at a warm wooden cafe table with an open notebook, pen and coffee; no faces, no logos.
Hands passing a clipboard (application/CV) across a wooden desk by a bright window, files and laptop beside; no faces, wide 2:1 crop

Older woman mentoring a younger man over a laptop at a rustic wooden table, cream wall and lamp, soft warm light; Western setting rather than South Asian  [REPLACED by the halal no-face policy: faces (woman and man)]
Closed navy-and-gold mushaf on a classic X-shaped wooden rehal over a prayer mat (Kaaba/clock-tower weave behind); on-brand navy+gold, slightly busy mat
OPTIONAL extra: open Quran on a wooden reading stand in a mosque with arched lattice windows behind, warm moody light (portrait)
Stack of gilded Qurans/Islamic books with wooden prayer beads on top, shallow focus, warm light; soft pink blurred background (portrait)

Cut-out of a white ankle-length thobe on a red hanger held up by a hand (hand and wrist only); the man, shopping bag and clothes rail from the original are removed, and the small brand tag at the collar was retouched out.

Crop of two open-front abayas (brown and black, wide sleeves) hanging on red hangers from a chrome rail, with a beige and a grey men's thobe beside them; the person standing next to the rack in the original is cropped out, no body or face.

Men's cream and white check handloom cotton kurta (mandarin collar, button placket, knee-length) on a hanger against a dark curtain; it is on a hanger, not flat-lay; the tiny maker mark embossed on the hanger was blurred out.

description: Crop of a market shelf piled with white embroidered and openwork kufi (taqiyah) prayer caps on a blue tarp; several caps rather than a single cap, no people.

Four rolled striped cotton scarves in muted powder blue, mauve, sand and grey on a plain white surface, no labels or people; rolled rather than folded, and the uploader account is a small shop (MADEINEGYPT.CA).
Cropped torso of a man in a crisp white thobe with folded hands against a plain pale-grey wall; no face, product-style (landscape)  [REPLACED by the halal no-face policy: man's torso]

Woman in a flowing mauve abaya with crescent-embroidered cuffs and brown hijab, full length, in a white room with window and column; adult face, fashion pose (portrait)  [REPLACED by the halal no-face policy: woman]

Rugged desert mountain ranges at golden sunrise seen through a rocky valley (Sinai-style), layered haze and a big clean gold sky for text
